entities.summary: Lance Hoyt, better known by his ring name Lance Archer, is an American professional wrestler. He is signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW), where is a member of The Don Callis Family. He also makes appearances for New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW), where he is a former two-time IWGP United States Heavyweight Champion. He is also known for his time with WWE as Vance Archer, and Impact Wrestling (TNA) under his real name and as Lance Rock.
